name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) is a Central Sector Scheme launched on 1 June 2020 by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India. The scheme aims to formalize street vendors and enhance their economic opportunities through collateral-free working capital loans, interest subsidy and digital transaction incentives. The scheme supports vendors in restarting and expanding their businesses and promotes digital payments and financial inclusion. Street vendors include hawkers, thelewala, rehriwala, theliphadwala and others engaged in small-scale vending activities.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_groups: Rural Street Vendors vending within ULB geographical limits
benefits: First working-capital loan tranche up to ₹15,000 with repayment within 12 months.
Second working-capital loan tranche up to ₹25,000 with repayment within 18 months.
Third working-capital loan tranche up to ₹50,000 with repayment within 36 months.
Next loan tranche is available on timely or early repayment.
No prepayment penalty on early repayment.
Interest subsidy at 7% per annum on the loan amount.
Interest subsidy is credited quarterly to the beneficiary's bank account.
Interest subsidy is applicable only for standard (non-NPA) accounts.
Interest subsidy is valid up to 31 March 2033.
Cashback up to ₹100 per month for digital transactions.
Credit guarantee cover of 31.87% for the first tranche loan.
Credit guarantee cover of 8.25% for the second tranche loan.
Credit guarantee cover of 6% for the third tranche loan.
No credit guarantee charges for lending institutions.
UPI-linked RuPay credit card with initial credit limit of ₹10,000, extendable up to ₹30,000.
UPI-linked RuPay credit card has a validity of 5 years.
UPI-linked RuPay credit card is available after successful repayment of the second loan tranche.

rules.description: Applicant must satisfy at least one of the source-supported vendor identification conditions: (1) Street vendor possessing a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by an Urban Local Body (ULB). (2) Vendor identified in the survey but not yet issued a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card. (3) Street vendor left out of the ULB-led identification survey or who started vending after completion of the survey and has a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the ULB or Town Vending Committee (TVC). (4) Vendor from surrounding development, peri-urban or rural areas vending within the geographical limits of a ULB and possessing an LoR issued by the ULB or TVC.

documents.description: Certificate of Vending issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB). Required for Category A/B vendors applying for the first loan.
Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB). Required for Category A/B vendors applying for the first loan.
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the ULB or Town Vending Committee (TVC). Required for Category C/D vendors applying for the first loan.
Aadhaar Card. KYC document required in addition to Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation.
Voter Identity Card. KYC document required in addition to Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation.
Driving License. KYC document required in addition to Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation.
MGNREGA Card. KYC document required in addition to Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation.
PAN Card. KYC document required in addition to Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation.

documents.document_name: Copy of Account Statement or Passbook
documents.description: Copy of Account Statement or Passbook. Supporting document for Letter of Recommendation for Category C/D vendors.

documents.document_name: Membership Card or other proof of membership
documents.description: Copy of Membership Card or other proof of membership. Supporting document for Letter of Recommendation for Category C/D vendors.

documents.document_name: Any other document to substantiate the claim as a vendor
documents.description: Any other document to substantiate the claim as a vendor. Supporting document for Letter of Recommendation for Category C/D vendors.
Request letter to the Urban Local Body. Supporting document for Letter of Recommendation for Category C/D vendors.
Loan Closure Document. Required for second and subsequent loan tranches.

tutorial_steps.title: Select vendor category
tutorial_steps.description: After successful login, select the valid vendor category from the available options.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter Survey Reference Number
tutorial_steps.description: Enter the Survey Reference Number (SRN), which is mandatory.

tutorial_steps.title: Refer to the User Manual
tutorial_steps.description: For detailed stepwise instructions, refer to the User Manual at https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/Default/ViewFile/?id=Helping+User+Manual+For+First+Term+Other+State.pdf&path=MiscFiles.

tutorial_steps.title: Contact toll-free helpline
tutorial_steps.description: For queries, call the toll-free number 1800111979. Timing: 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday, except national holidays.

tutorial_steps.title: View contact details
tutorial_steps.description: Visit https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/Home/Contact for contact details. UMANG is also available as an application channel.
